selection: 100 contiguous peripheral communes grown from the HoàiĐức/QuốcOai seed by exact polygon-touch BFS-nearest-to-seed-centroid, excluding the 12 historical central urban districts (HoànKiếm, BaĐình, ĐốngĐa, HaiBàTrưng, CầuGiấy, ThanhXuân, TâyHồ, HoàngMai, LongBiên, BắcTừLiêm, NamTừLiêm, HàĐông); connectivity verified
interpretation: communes are demand origins SERVED by the 50 candidate sites (complete routing graph), not 100 on-site facilities
arrivals: integer children per commune per hour drawn in [ceil(0.2x), floor(0.3x)] with x the commune children_under_5, sum preserved; constrained sequential sampling over a random hour permutation with feasible remainder; small infeasible totals rejected
capacity: balanced: per-hour totals split across sites with largest_remainder_split over hour-rotated site order; surplus per-hour total = ceil(1.1 * arrivals); synthetic, no real operational capacity in facilities.csv
demand: children_under_5 is the HRSL 2020 integer proxy estimate (Meta HRSL under-5 via HDX), NOT observed vaccine demand
distance: haversine kilometres subset by source IDs from data/processed/case1/distance_matrix.csv; NOT road distance, no road data forged
coordinate_caveats: GADM 4.1 historical commune boundaries differ from current Hanoi administrative units; facility coordinates are OSM polygon centers (school entrances unverified); site status is candidate, unverified
